hypothesis: In SOLUSDT 4h low-volatility trend contexts, a Donchian channel breakout accompanied by abnormal relative volume has positive net expectancy after an all-in 15bp round-trip execution-cost proxy and actual historical funding; a same-direction BTC trend filter may reduce false breakouts.

data.source: Persisted Binance USDⓈ-M canonical 4h OHLCV and SOL funding archive

split.method: chronological 60/20/20 with 12-bar purge/embargo on both sides of each boundary

ema.method: recursive EMA, computed causally from first bar

features.trendFlatThreshold: training q20 of abs(EMA50/EMA200 - 1), fit separately for SOL and BTC
features.volatilityThreshold: training q33 of ATR14/close, fit on SOL
features.shockThreshold: training q99 of abs 4h log return, fit on SOL
features.relativeVolume: current completed-bar volume / median of preceding 20 completed-bar volumes

detector.shock: exclude if abs 4h log return > training q99
detector.bullLow: SOL EMA50 > EMA200, abs spread > training q20 flat threshold, SOL ATR14/close <= training q33
detector.bearLow: SOL EMA50 < EMA200, abs spread > training q20 flat threshold, SOL ATR14/close <= training q33
detector.btcConfirmation: if enabled, BTC EMA50/EMA200 must be non-flat under BTC training q20 threshold and point in the same direction as SOL

rules.signal: completed close breaks the prior N-bar high (long) or low (short), excluding current bar; relative volume >= training q70; signal context BULL_LOW/BEAR_LOW
rules.direction: long in BULL_LOW; short in BEAR_LOW
rules.stop: entry +/- ATR14(signal bar) * selected stop multiple
rules.timeStop: close at the end of the 12th holding bar
rules.position: 1 SOL fixed quantity; one position at a time; no pyramiding
rules.intrabar: stop-first if stop and target both touched; adverse gap-through stop fills at bar open; target fills at target; time stop fills at close
rules.ambiguousEntry: if no next bar exists, skip

selection: Select highest validation mean net R among variants with at least 20 validation trades; ties resolved by lower validation max drawdown, then shorter lookback, then BTC confirmation enabled. If no variant reaches 20 validation trades, do not evaluate untouched test.

costs.funding: actual SOLUSDT funding settlements; funding cash flow = direction * rate * settlement markPrice * 1 SOL; if settlement markPrice is blank use entry price and count the fallback
costs.slippage: included in 15bp proxy; no separate latency model

baselines.unconditionalDonchian: same selected lookback, stop, target and time stop; no low-volatility context, no relative-volume filter, no BTC confirmation
baselines.buyHold: SOL close-to-close return over untouched test interval

uncertainty.method: circular moving-block bootstrap over ordered trade net-R sequence
uncertainty.multipleTesting: Holm correction across all 18 validation variants; only one frozen selected variant is evaluated on untouched test

noTrade: BTC filter enabled and BTC direction is not aligned
missing/non-finite OHLCV or invalid contract/data state
executionPolicy: No order placement. Research-only historical simulation.
preRegistration: Frozen before data retrieval and backtest execution; validation selects one of 18 variants; untouched test must not be used for tuning.
